title: ERD Studio domain
description: A domain diagram: .erd-studio/{layer}/{domain}.json. References models by name and holds relationships and canvas layout. Reference: https://github.com/liam-machine/erd-studio/blob/main/docs/semantic-domain-json-reference.md#domain-file-erd-studiolayerdomainjson

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editors outside VS Code. Ignored by ERD Studio.

schemaVersion.description: Domain file format version. Write 5. Version 4 (inline model objects) still loads until migrated with "ERD Studio: Migrate Domains to Central Model Store".

domain.description: Domain slug. Should equal the file name without .json.

layer.description: Must match an id in layers.json and the parent directory name.

modelFolder.description: Path prefix filter for the "Add Existing Model" dialog, e.g. models/silver.

stubColumns.description: Models (typically conformed dimensions / reference tables) that define only key columns. Missing-column discrepancies for them are hidden in Compare.

models.description: Model NAME strings. Each resolves to .erd-studio/logical-models/{name}.yml or .erd-studio/logical-models/{folder}/{name}.yml. (Version 4 files hold inline model objects here instead; never mix the two.)

anyOf.description: Deprecated version 4 inline model. Migrate to a name string.

relationships.description: FK relationships. (fromModel, fromColumn, toModel, toColumn) must be unique within the domain.

viewConfig.description: Deprecated location — viewConfig belongs at the root of the document.
Canvas layout, at the root of the document. Write {} for a new domain — models without a position are placed automatically.

fromModel.description: Model holding the FK (the "many" side of many-to-one).

cardinality.description: Relationship cardinality, read from fromModel to toModel.

viewConfig.description: Canvas layout. Safe to leave as {} — models without a position are placed automatically.

layoutOptions.description: ELK layout options as string key/value pairs, e.g. "elk.direction": "DOWN".

positions.description: Node positions keyed by model name. Preserve existing entries when adding models.

linkedModel.description: Draws a dashed edge from the note to this model.
